$comment: Vendoring metadata for iso4217_snapshot.json (qlf-sentinel client contract CC-2). Read by tools/check_snapshot_freshness.py, which prefers this file over the snapshot's embedded meta, and by tests/test_snapshot_meta.py. The snapshot keeps its own embedded meta (read by check_iso4217_snapshot.py, gen_iso4217_snapshot.py and gen_state_doc.py); every key present in both meta objects must have the same value, and source_version must equal the embedded iso4217_version. vendored_at is the author date of the last commit that changed the snapshot: git log -1 --format=%ad --date=short -- tools/iso4217_snapshot.json. refresh_cadence is monthly, quarterly or yearly, and review_by = vendored_at + 1 cadence period (1, 3 or 12 calendar months, same day of month, clamped to the month's last day; tools/cadence.py).
